title: Using feature optimization and LightGBM algorithm to predict the clinical pregnancy outcomes after in vitro fertilization.
summary: Repeated five-fold cross-validation of IVF-cycle records selected LightGBM for pregnancy-outcome prediction (accuracy 92.31%, recall 87.80%, F1 90.00%, AUC 0.9041) and identified estrogen at HCG, endometrial thickness, infertility duration and BMI as important features. This is retrospective counseling evidence, not treatment-effect evidence. AI role: LightGBM with feature optimization. The article appeared in Frontiers In Endocrinology.
organization: School of Basic Medicine, Anhui Medical University, Hefei, China.; Center of Reproductive Medicine, Children's Hospital of Shanxi and Women Health Center of Shanxi, Taiyuan, China.; School of Information, Shanxi University of Finance and Economics, Taiyuan, China.
